definitions.gloss: contrast agent; contrast medium; contrast dye
definitions.explanation: A substance given to a patient to make certain tissues, organs, or blood vessels show up more clearly on medical images such as X-rays, CT scans, or MRI. Typical types include iodine-based and barium compounds for X-ray/CT and gadolinium-based agents for MRI.

examples.japanese: {検査|けんさ}の{前|まえ}に{造影剤|ぞうえいざい}を{注射|ちゅうしゃ}します。
examples.english: Before the examination, a contrast agent is injected.

examples.japanese: {造影剤|ぞうえいざい}にアレルギーはありますか。
examples.english: Do you have any allergies to contrast agents?

examples.japanese: {造影剤|ぞうえいざい}を{使|つか}うと{血管|けっかん}や{腫瘍|しゅよう}がはっきりと{写|うつ}る。
examples.english: Using a contrast agent makes blood vessels and tumors show up clearly.

examples.japanese: {造影剤|ぞうえいざい}を{使|つか}った{検査|けんさ}では、まれに{副作用|ふくさよう}が{現|あらわ}れることがあるので、{事前|じぜん}の{問診|もんしん}が{重要|じゅうよう}です。
examples.english: Rare side effects can occur in examinations using contrast agents, so a pre-examination interview is important.

notes:
Composed of {造影|ぞうえい} (creating an image; contrast imaging) and {剤|ざい} (agent, drug, preparation). The suffix {剤|ざい} appears in many pharmaceutical terms, such as {鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい} (painkiller) and {消毒剤|しょうどくざい} (disinfectant).

USAGE:
This is the standard medical term used in hospitals, imaging clinics, and consent forms. Patients are commonly asked whether they have a {造影剤|ぞうえいざい}アレルギー before CT or MRI scans. {造影剤|ぞうえいざい} can be given intravenously, orally (such as barium for stomach X-rays), or by other routes depending on the examination.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {造影剤|ぞうえいざい}を{使|つか}う: to use a contrast agent
- {造影剤|ぞうえいざい}を{注射|ちゅうしゃ}する: to inject a contrast agent
- {造影剤|ぞうえいざい}アレルギー: allergy to contrast agents
- {造影剤|ぞうえいざい}{副作用|ふくさよう}: side effect of a contrast agent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {造影|ぞうえい}{検査|けんさ}: contrast-enhanced examination — the procedure that uses a contrast agent
- {薬剤|やくざい}: medicine, drug preparation — the broader category
- バリウム: barium — a specific contrast material used for stomach X-rays
- {麻酔|ますい}{薬|やく}: anesthetic — a different kind of medical agent sometimes confused in translation
